description: Wave plan for .testmuai/tests. No wave holds two tests that use the same single-use credential, and tests that mutate the same fixture are split. See docs/hack-os/TEST_WAVES.md.
procedure: cd <this repo> && KANE_CLI_USER_AGENT=<agent> kane-cli testrun run <the wave's tests> --parallel 4 < /dev/null
